Questions answered

Painter invoice FAQs

What belongs on a painter invoice?

Include project address, measured scope, preparation, labour, paint and supplies, tax, advances, total and due date.

Can painting be billed per square foot?

Yes. Enter square feet as the quantity and the agreed rate for each type of work.

Should paint and labour be separate?

Separate them when materials are supplied by the painter or when the agreement prices them independently.

How do I show a painting advance?

Show the full stage or project amount and deduct the advance already received.

Can I use this for commercial painting?

Yes. Add work-order references, site details, measured quantities and the customer's required tax information.
